Leaders Skip UN General Assembly Amid Shifting Global Politics

Over 50 world leaders, including Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, Friedrich Merz, Giorgia Meloni, and Mahmoud Abbas, will not attend the UN General Assembly. Reasons cited for their absence include illness, domestic affairs, and holidays. The UN General Assembly is reportedly gaining prominence due to gridlock in the UN Security Council and the emergence of multipolarity.
